title: HOW THE KERNEL WORKS · one ask, from your words to the record
kept_by: the kernel — served the same on every door (GET /map); Fable turns it with every spoonful that changes a part named here, as the guide turns with the glass (canon 0011 §4c, JB's lock 2026-10-14)
words: Orreth is a kernel: one process that holds the doors, runs every body through one ring, meters every mind, writes every act to a signed record, and watches the whole. The graph you make runs INSIDE the ring — the kernel's laws never hide in your nodes.
